message.content: The case involves three claims about a map and its case in Keel City records. Claim A, that the archive acquired the map case in 1962, is well supported by the accession book (S1) and can be confidently included in the public entry. Claim B, stating the map has no fold on its western edge, is contradicted by a condition report (S3) documenting a fold, so it should be excluded. Claim C, regarding the original map plate being engraved in 1893, is based on an undated label (S2) and remains unresolved due to lack of definitive evidence. Therefore, only Claim A is suitable for the public entry at this time.
